data.name: Sleighers
data.detailed_description:
You have a gun that shoots festive lights, there are bare evergreen trees in town, and there are two teams, one of arctic animals, the other of mythical creatures, but both need holiday cheer!

Great. How do you play? Always remember the acronym: STEAL!



Shoot to decorate! Your gun shoots lights, it only makes sense!

Trees grant cheer! Make sure your team has decorated trees!

Eliminate the other team! They want to decorate trees also, we can't have that!

Acquire their trees! They have decorated trees, take them for your team!

Lookout for Blizzards! It's cold out there, and you might freeze. Head indoors, but kills grant cheer when conditions outside are frightful...

This battle is so delightful!

data.short_description: A festive anthro-themed hero shooter set in the atmospheric and whimsical Arctic Circle. Choose your class, and help your team decorate and dominate in this more festive twist on the Domination game mode, but watch out for Old Man Winter and his periodic blizzards!
